Multithreaded HTTP Server

January 2024 – March 2024

I developed a multithreaded HTTP server in C that processes simultaneous client connections and supports HTTP GET and PUT requests. The project strengthened my understanding of socket programming, concurrency, synchronization, and server-side file management.

Key engineering work:

  • Created a new worker thread for each client connection.
  • Implemented HTTP request parsing and response generation.
  • Supported file uploads and downloads through PUT and GET.
  • Used semaphores and read-write locks to prevent unsafe concurrent file access.
  • Added client-server messaging alongside file-transfer functionality.

Technologies: C, POSIX sockets, pthreads, semaphores, read-write locks, HTTP

Distributed Multi-Server Backup System

April 2024 – June 2024

I built a distributed key-value storage and backup system consisting of three cooperating servers. The servers replicate data and use vector clocks to preserve causal relationships between updates.

Key engineering work:

  • Implemented three asynchronous FastAPI servers.
  • Used vector clocks to track the causal order of key-value updates.
  • Replicated updated values and clock information between servers.
  • Compared client and server clocks before returning requested values.
  • Delayed stale responses until the server received an acceptable version.
  • Used Python coroutines and HTTPX for asynchronous communication.

Technologies: Python, FastAPI, HTTPX, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, vector clocks

Full-Stack Key-Value Storage System

July 2024 – September 2024

I developed a browser-based key-value storage application with a React frontend and an Express and MongoDB backend. The application provides a clear interface for adding, retrieving, and deleting stored values.

Key engineering work:

  • Designed the frontend with reusable React components.
  • Created RESTful backend routes with Node.js and Express.
  • Stored and retrieved key-value records with MongoDB.
  • Supported both local and remote database connections.
  • Generated interactive API documentation with Swagger.
  • Connected frontend actions to backend JSON request and response flows.

Technologies: React, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Swagger, REST APIs

A-Star Path Planning and Navigation System

January 2025 – March 2025

I implemented a navigation system for an intelligent vehicle in Unity. The system transforms a polygonal environment into convex navigation regions and uses the A-star algorithm to plan a valid route to a target.

Key engineering work:

  • Identified concave inset points within polygonal maps.
  • Applied recursive bisection to divide maps into convex regions.
  • Represented neighboring regions as a searchable navigation graph.
  • Used A-star search to select an efficient path across the graph.
  • Generated waypoints from region centers and shared-edge midpoints.
  • Controlled vehicle movement while keeping it inside the map boundaries.

Technologies: C#, Unity, A-star search, graph algorithms, computational geometry, path planning
